effort.input_format: same cleaned summary and description as priority model
effort.target_source: positive timeestimate_seconds first; positive timespent_seconds fallback; zero/non-positive is missing

known_limitations: Effort is a coarse Jira transfer/proxy model trained on 1,877 positive labels: timeestimate first and timespent fallback; zero/non-positive values are missing.
Estimated minutes are calibrated bucket medians/ranges, not a guaranteed continuous duration; user-entered duration always takes precedence.
Deadline and urgency remain explicit-input/text/rule based; personal importance remains user-confirmed.
The scheduler splits model-estimated work across available days instead of treating a large estimate as one session.
